_comment: Hand-maintained. Key = display name in the app. born/died = years (died must be < 1956). Optional: dates (display override, must end in the death year), aka (Bartlett heading names, title-cased, that map to this author), note. Bios are one neutral factual line written by us (specs.md 4.3).

Alexander Pope.bio: English poet and satirist; also translated Homer's Iliad and Odyssey.

John Milton.bio: English poet, author of Paradise Lost.

Lord Byron.bio: English Romantic poet, author of Don Juan.

William Wordsworth.bio: English Romantic poet and Poet Laureate.

Plutarch.bio: Greek biographer and essayist, author of the Parallel Lives.

Samuel Johnson.bio: English writer and compiler of A Dictionary of the English Language.

Alfred, Lord Tennyson.bio: Poet Laureate for most of Queen Victoria’s reign.

William Cowper.bio: English poet of country life, author of The Task.

Miguel de Cervantes.bio: Spanish novelist, author of Don Quixote.

Marcus Aurelius.bio: Roman emperor and Stoic philosopher who wrote the Meditations.

John Dryden.bio: English poet, playwright and critic; the first Poet Laureate.

Thomas Moore.bio: Irish poet and songwriter, author of Irish Melodies.

Samuel Butler.bio: English satirical poet, author of Hudibras.

Edward Young.bio: English poet, author of Night Thoughts.

Samuel Taylor Coleridge.bio: English Romantic poet, author of The Rime of the Ancient Mariner.

Michel de Montaigne.bio: French writer who made the essay a literary form.

Henry Wadsworth Longfellow.bio: American poet of Hiawatha and Paul Revere’s Ride.
